statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, CISA adds a SiteGuard WAF vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries an entry whose vendorProject, product, or shortDescription field contains SiteGuard, with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01 inclusive.
failure_condition: No SiteGuard vulnerability is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-06, the US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield closes at or above 5.25 percent on at least one business day. Reference: 5.10 percent on the packet date (prior-session close).
resolution: FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.25 or higher for at least one date between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-06 inclusive. Reference: 5.10 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield stays below 5.25 percent on every business day from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-06.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-06, the CME NYMEX WTI crude futures contract nearest expiry settles at or above 110.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day. Reference: 99.02 dollars on the packet date (prior-session close).
resolution: CME Group settlement data for the WTI contract nearest expiry shows a daily settlement of 110.00 or higher on at least one trading day between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-06 inclusive. Reference: 99.02 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The WTI contract nearest expiry settles below 110.00 dollars per barrel on every trading day from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-06.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, a Ukrainian drone attack damages an energy facility in Saint Petersburg or Leningrad Oblast.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, BBC, and Al Jazeera report a Ukrainian drone attack that damaged an oil, fuel, port, or power facility in Saint Petersburg or Leningrad Oblast between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian drone attack damages an energy facility in Saint Petersburg or Leningrad Oblast between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, Russia launches at least 500 drones and missiles combined against Ukraine in a single overnight attack.
resolution: The Ukrainian Air Force reports at least 500 drones and missiles combined launched in one overnight attack between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, confirmed by at least two of Reuters, AP, BBC, and Al Jazeera.
failure_condition: No single overnight Russian attack launches 500 or more drones and missiles combined at Ukraine between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, United States or Israeli forces strike a target inside Iran and the US or Israeli government publicly acknowledges the strike.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, BBC, and Al Jazeera report an air, missile, or drone strike on a target inside Iran between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, acknowledged by the US or Israeli government.
failure_condition: No strike on a target inside Iran is carried out and acknowledged by the US or Israeli government between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, an earthquake of magnitude 5.0 or greater strikes within 100 km of Khuzdar, Pakistan.
resolution: The USGS ComCat catalog lists an earthquake of magnitude 5.0 or greater with epicenter within 100 km of 27.80 N 66.62 E and origin time between 2026-10-19 00:00 UTC and 2026-11-01 23:59 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 5.0 or greater occurs within 100 km of Khuzdar, Pakistan between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-26, the center of Hurricane Trudy makes landfall on the Mexican coast with maximum sustained winds of at least 74 mph.
resolution: NHC advisories or the NHC Tropical Cyclone Report for Trudy state that its center crossed the Mexican coast between 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-26 with maximum sustained winds of at least 74 mph.
failure_condition: Trudy does not cross the Mexican coast as a hurricane with sustained winds of at least 74 mph between 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-26.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08, the person serving as French Prime Minister on 2026-10-18 resigns, is dismissed, or is replaced.
resolution: The Journal Officiel or the Elysee publishes a decree or statement ending the functions of the Prime Minister in office on 2026-10-18, or naming a successor, with effect dated between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08.
failure_condition: The Prime Minister in office on 2026-10-18 remains in office, with no resignation, dismissal, or successor taking effect between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, an official French figure puts cumulative arrests in the student-led protest wave at 3,000 or more. Reference: 1,800 arrests reported by 2026-10-18.
resolution: A French Interior Ministry, police, or prosecutor figure published between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01 and relayed by two of Reuters, AP, AFP, and the Guardian puts cumulative protest-related arrests at 3,000 or more. Reference: 1,800 on 2026-10-18.
failure_condition: Cumulative arrests in the French student-led protest wave remain below 3,000 through 2026-11-01.
